[SWS_DM_01376] Response behavior of SOVD services without access rights
⌈
If the request is an SOVD request and the service execution verification fails
due to a failed check in scope of [SWS_DM_01223], the Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall send a HTTP response status code 401 (Unauthorized) and error_code
set to insufficient-access-rights and stop the service processing.
⌋
